title: priskinator policy, version 1
description: One policy layer: built-in defaults, an org baseline, or a repo policy (ADR 0010). Unknown keys are errors.

extends.description: The layer this one builds on. Repo policy always extends the org baseline; the key exists for clarity only.

case_sensitive.description: Match paths case-sensitively. Off by default, because macOS and Windows checkouts are case-insensitive (ADR 0006).

max_file_bytes.description: Files larger than this fire G10.oversize-file.

max_changed_files.description: Diffs touching more files than this skip scoring and fire oversize (ADR 0003).

max_changed_lines.description: Diffs with more added plus removed lines than this skip scoring and fire oversize (ADR 0003).

triggers.description: Mandatory human-review rules by stable ID (ADR 0006). G1-G10 are baseline rules; new rules use the org. or repo. namespace.

thresholds.description: Total points at which the score tier becomes medium and high (ADR 0007).

factors.description: Points bands per factor. Each band covers raw values up to and including up_to; the last band has no up_to.

size.description: Lines added plus removed, excluding generated and vendored files.

files.description: Files changed, excluding generated and vendored files.

complexity_delta.description: Sum of per-function cyclomatic complexity increases.

test_signal.description: Non-test lines changed when no test file changed.

floors.description: Criticality floors: a minimum risk for changes to these paths.

exclude_paths.description: Paths left out of size and diffusion, in addition to linguist-generated and linguist-vendored files.

ai.description: Optional AI assessment (ADR 0008). Disabled unless enabled here.

required.description: Set in the org baseline to stop repos from disabling the AI.

glob.description: doublestar glob over repository-relative paths with forward slashes.

risk.description: Risk floor applied when the rule fires.
